heads.title: South Korea's exports top $1 trillion for first time on chip boom
(LEAD) S. Korea's exports top US$1 tln for 1st time on strong chip demand
South Korea becomes fourth country globally to hit US$1 trillion exports on AI chip boom
South Korea's Exports Top $1 Trillion for First Time on AI Boom
South Korea rides AI boom to new height as exports hit $1 trillion

paragraphs.en: South Korea's cumulative exports for 2026 passed the $1 trillion mark for the first time on Thursday, Nov. 19, more than a month before the end of the year, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources announced. The threshold was crossed at 2:09 p.m., a year after shipments first topped $700 billion and 62 years after they reached $100 million. South Korea becomes the fourth country to join the club, after Germany, the United States and China, and the first newcomer in 19 years, according to The Korea Herald. Germany and the U.S. had crossed the line in 2006 and China followed in 2007, riding a trade boom after Beijing joined the World Trade Organization. Last year's record stood at $709.3 billion, and the ministry projects full-year shipments of $1.17 trillion, roughly 65 percent more than that.
paragraphs.ko: 한국의 올해 누적 수출이 11월 19일 목요일, 연말을 한 달 넘게 앞두고 처음으로 1조 달러를 넘었다고 산업통상자원부가 발표했어요. 1조 달러선은 오후 2시 9분에 넘었는데, 수출이 처음 7천억 달러를 넘은 지 1년, 1억 달러에 이른 지 62년 만이에요. 한국은 독일, 미국, 중국에 이어 네 번째로 이 대열에 들었고, 코리아헤럴드에 따르면 19년 만의 첫 신규 진입국이에요. 독일과 미국은 2006년에, 중국은 중국이 세계무역기구(WTO)에 가입한 뒤의 무역 호황을 타고 2007년에 이 선을 넘었어요. 지난해 기록은 7,093억 달러였고, 산업부는 올해 연간 수출을 1조 1,700억 달러로 내다보는데 이는 그보다 약 65퍼센트 많은 수치예요.

paragraphs.en: The ministry credited semiconductors and computers as the main engines of growth, as global technology companies have stepped up spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure. Chip exports came to roughly $397 billion in the first 10 months, nearly triple the $135 billion of a year earlier and about 43 percent of all shipments. Total exports over the period reached $930.2 billion, according to the Herald's account of the ministry's figures. CNA, relying on a Reuters report, added that chip exports in the first three quarters had jumped 184 percent and that their share was more than double the 20 percent average of the past five years. Demand from AI data centers pushed up prices of DRAM and NAND memory, and the build-out also lifted shipments of solid-state drives, transformers, cables and copper. Petrochemicals, ships and display panels also contributed, and cosmetics and pharmaceuticals logged their highest-ever export figures despite rising protectionism and prolonged tension in the Middle East.
paragraphs.ko: 산업부는 세계 기술 기업들이 인공지능(AI) 인프라 투자를 늘리면서 반도체와 컴퓨터가 성장의 주된 동력이었다고 밝혔어요. 반도체 수출은 1~10월에 약 3,970억 달러로, 1년 전 1,350억 달러의 거의 세 배였고 전체 수출의 약 43퍼센트를 차지했어요. 코리아헤럴드가 전한 산업부 수치로는 같은 기간 전체 수출이 9,302억 달러에 이르렀어요. 로이터 보도를 바탕으로 한 CNA는 1~3분기 반도체 수출이 184퍼센트 뛰었고 비중이 지난 5년 평균 20퍼센트의 두 배를 넘었다고 덧붙였어요. AI 데이터센터 수요가 D램과 낸드 메모리 가격을 끌어올렸고, 이 건설 붐은 솔리드스테이트 드라이브(SSD), 변압기, 케이블, 구리의 수출도 늘렸어요. 석유화학, 선박, 디스플레이 패널도 보탬이 됐고, 보호무역주의 확산과 중동의 장기 긴장 속에서도 화장품과 의약품은 사상 최대 수출을 기록했어요.

paragraphs.en: Exports excluding chips climbed 20 percent, with 16 of 20 major product categories posting gains, the Herald reported. Cosmetics shipments hit $12.4 billion, already above last year's full-year record, and small and midsize companies also set an export record. Shipments rose in seven of nine major markets, led by China, up 88 percent, and the U.S., up 77 percent. Yonhap noted that exports to the U.S. had fallen 3.8 percent last year under higher tariffs imposed by President Donald Trump's administration but have since rebounded on stronger demand for memory chips used in AI servers. By CNA's account, traditional manufacturing sectors such as autos, steel and ships have lagged amid protectionism set off by U.S. tariffs and geopolitical conflicts including the Iran war.
paragraphs.ko: 코리아헤럴드는 반도체를 뺀 수출도 20퍼센트 늘었고 주요 20개 품목 가운데 16개가 증가했다고 전했어요. 화장품 수출은 124억 달러로 이미 지난해 연간 기록을 넘었고, 중소·중견 기업의 수출도 사상 최대였어요. 주요 9개 시장 가운데 7곳에서 수출이 늘었고, 중국이 88퍼센트, 미국이 77퍼센트 증가해 앞장섰어요. 연합뉴스는 트럼프 행정부가 올린 관세 탓에 지난해 대미 수출이 3.8퍼센트 줄었지만, AI 서버용 메모리 반도체 수요가 늘면서 이후 반등했다고 짚었어요. sents.ko: 주요 9개 시장 가운데 7곳에서 수출이 늘었고, 중국이 88퍼센트, 미국이 77퍼센트 증가해 앞장섰어요.

sents.en: Yonhap noted that exports to the U.S. had fallen 3.8 percent last year under higher tariffs imposed by President Donald Trump's administration but have since rebounded on stronger demand for memory chips used in AI servers.
sents.ko: 연합뉴스는 트럼프 행정부가 올린 관세 탓에 지난해 대미 수출이 3.8퍼센트 줄었지만, AI 서버용 메모리 반도체 수요가 늘면서 이후 반등했다고 짚었어요.

sents.en: By CNA's account, traditional manufacturing sectors such as autos, steel and ships have lagged amid protectionism set off by U.S. tariffs and geopolitical conflicts including the Iran war.
sents.ko: CNA는 미국 관세와 이란 전쟁 같은 지정학적 갈등이 불러온 보호무역주의 속에서 자동차, 철강, 선박 같은 전통 제조업은 뒤처졌다고 전했어요.

paragraphs.en: Imports rose 21 percent to $635.1 billion, leaving a trade surplus of about $295 billion through October, against $77.4 billion for all of last year, the Herald said. Yonhap put the surplus at $294.9 billion and said it was more than triple the previous full-year record of $95.2 billion, set in 2017. Kang Kam-chan, the deputy minister for trade and investment, reminded reporters that "part of the $1 trillion belongs to imports," citing steady supplies of crude oil, naphtha and chipmaking equipment. He also cautioned that much of the record reflects higher prices rather than higher output, as AI demand sent memory chip prices soaring and the export price of petroleum products jumped 62 percent to $1,105 a ton. In his words, the result is "remarkable" given a population of 51.6 million and an economy of just $1.88 trillion, smaller than any of its three predecessors had at the time.
paragraphs.ko: 수입은 21퍼센트 늘어 6,351억 달러였고, 코리아헤럴드에 따르면 10월까지 무역흑자는 약 2,950억 달러로 지난해 연간 774억 달러와 비교돼요. 연합뉴스는 흑자가 2,949억 달러로 2017년에 세운 종전 연간 기록 952억 달러의 세 배를 넘는다고 전했어요. 강감찬 통상교섭 담당 차관은 "1조 달러의 일부는 수입의 몫"이라며 원유, 나프타, 반도체 제조 장비의 안정적 조달을 꼽았어요. 그는 기록의 상당 부분이 생산량 증가가 아니라 가격 상승 덕분이라며, AI 수요로 메모리 가격이 치솟고 석유제품 수출 단가가 62퍼센트 올라 톤당 1,105달러가 됐다고 말했어요. 그는 인구 5,160만 명에 경제 규모 1조 8,800억 달러로 앞선 세 나라보다 작은 상황에서 이룬 "놀라운 성과"라고 평가했어요.

paragraphs.en: President Lee Jae Myung hailed the milestone on X as the fruit of generations of effort, paying tribute to workers who spent their youth in garment factories, shoe plants and shipyards. "The gains from exports must, above all, improve people's lives," Lee wrote, pledging that growth would reach large and small companies and communities across the country. He promised to strengthen key industries, nurture future engines such as AI and biotechnology, and support Korean consumer goods including beauty products and food as they expand abroad. The administration also plans a 162.3 trillion won ($121.94 billion) Future Response Fund to channel excess tax revenue from the chip boom toward growth industries, young people, regional development and education, CNA reported. Six major business groups welcomed the milestone in a joint statement and urged the government and companies to turn export growth into domestic investment, jobs and livelier regional economies.
paragraphs.ko: 이재명 대통령은 엑스(X)에 올린 글에서 이번 성과를 여러 세대가 쌓은 노력의 결실이라고 평가하며 봉제 공장, 신발 공장, 조선소에서 청춘을 보낸 노동자들에게 경의를 표했어요. 이 대통령은 "수출의 성과는 무엇보다 국민의 삶을 나아지게 해야 한다"고 쓰고, 성장이 대·중소기업과 전국 지역에 닿게 하겠다고 약속했어요. 그는 핵심 산업의 경쟁력을 높이고, AI와 바이오 같은 미래 성장동력을 키우며, 해외로 뻗는 화장품과 식품 등 한국 소비재를 적극 돕겠다고 밝혔어요. CNA는 정부가 반도체 호황으로 늘어난 초과 세수를 성장 산업, 청년, 지역 발전, 교육에 돌리기 위해 162조 3천억 원(1,219억 4천만 달러) 규모의 미래대응기금을 만들 계획이라고 전했어요. 6개 주요 경제단체는 공동 성명에서 이번 성과를 환영하며 정부와 기업이 수출 성장을 국내 투자, 일자리, 지역 경제 활성화로 잇자고 촉구했어요.

paragraphs.en: Kang acknowledged that the gains have flowed mostly to large companies, pointing to structural limits in chips and petrochemicals, which have short supply chains and employ relatively few workers compared with automobiles or ships. "It is regrettable that the profits have not flowed through to suppliers," he said, suggesting that new chip plants and joint research with equipment makers could spread the benefits. CNA noted that domestic demand in Asia's fourth-largest economy remains weak, with consumer sentiment hurt by high interest rates and prices and by unprecedented volatility in the stock market. The finance minister said last month that growth is expected to accelerate to the mid-3 percent range this year, after 1 percent last year, as the AI boom fuels exports and investment. The Herald added that a big surplus would normally lift the won, but many exporters keep their dollar earnings abroad or spend them on imported parts and overseas factories, so less of the surplus reaches the currency market.
paragraphs.ko: 강 차관은 반도체와 석유화학은 공급망이 짧고 자동차나 선박보다 고용이 적은 구조적 한계가 있어 성과가 대기업에 집중됐다고 인정했어요. 그는 "이익이 협력사로 흘러가지 못한 점은 아쉽다"며 신규 반도체 공장과 장비업체와의 공동 연구가 혜택을 넓힐 수 있다고 말했어요. CNA는 아시아 4위 경제의 내수가 여전히 약하고, 높은 금리와 물가, 전례 없는 주식시장 변동성이 소비심리를 짓누른다고 짚었어요. 재정경제부 장관은 지난달 AI 붐이 수출과 투자를 끌어올려 올해 성장률이 지난해 1퍼센트에서 3퍼센트대 중반으로 높아질 것이라고 밝혔어요. 코리아헤럴드는 큰 흑자가 보통 원화 가치를 끌어올리지만, 많은 수출 기업이 번 달러를 해외에 두거나 수입 부품과 해외 공장에 쓰기 때문에 흑자가 외환시장에 덜 닿는다고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: The semiconductor story rests on high-bandwidth memory, or HBM, a stack of DRAM chips connected through dense interconnections to feed data quickly to the processors that train and run AI models, The Korea Herald explained in a separate piece. Production is dominated by three companies: Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and the U.S.-based Micron Technology. According to Counterpoint Research, SK hynix held 50 percent of the global HBM market by revenue in the second quarter of 2026, ahead of Samsung with 33 percent and Micron with 18 percent. The memory boom pushed both Korean chipmakers to record quarterly profits: Samsung's third-quarter operating profit surged 783.1 percent to 107.44 trillion won ($80.5 billion), while SK hynix's jumped 632.1 percent to 83.33 trillion won. SK hynix credited its collaboration with Korean materials, components and equipment suppliers as a key contributor to the export milestone.
paragraphs.ko: 코리아헤럴드는 별도 기사에서 반도체 호황의 중심에 고대역폭 메모리(HBM)가 있다고 설명했는데, HBM은 D램을 쌓아 촘촘한 배선으로 이어 AI 모델을 학습·구동하는 프로세서에 데이터를 빠르게 공급하는 제품이에요. 생산은 삼성전자, SK하이닉스, 미국 마이크론 테크놀로지 세 곳이 장악하고 있어요. 카운터포인트리서치에 따르면 2026년 2분기 매출 기준 세계 HBM 시장에서 SK하이닉스가 50퍼센트, 삼성이 33퍼센트, 마이크론이 18퍼센트를 차지했어요. 메모리 호황으로 두 한국 반도체 기업 모두 분기 최대 이익을 냈어요. 삼성의 3분기 영업이익은 783.1퍼센트 급증한 107조 4,400억 원(805억 달러), SK하이닉스는 632.1퍼센트 늘어난 83조 3,300억 원이었어요. SK하이닉스는 국내 소재·부품·장비 기업과의 협력이 이번 수출 기록의 핵심 요인이라고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: Kang expects chip exports to keep supporting overall shipments through at least the third quarter of 2027, citing demand from big technology firms building data centers. He said exports could top $1 trillion again next year, though easing chip and oil prices could pull them below this year's level, and he named delays in U.S. data center projects, Chinese competition and protectionism as risks. The ministry also warned of price volatility in chips and petrochemicals, rising protectionism in the U.S. and the European Union, and intensifying competition amid global oversupply. Economic research institutes forecast that export growth will slow in 2027 because of a base effect, though annual exports are projected to stay around $1 trillion. The Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade urged steps to protect the competitiveness of domestic industries given uneven growth across sectors and volatile exchange rates.
paragraphs.ko: 강 차관은 대형 기술 기업의 데이터센터 건설 수요를 근거로 반도체 수출이 적어도 2027년 3분기까지 전체 수출을 떠받칠 것으로 내다봤어요. 그는 내년에도 수출이 1조 달러를 넘을 수 있지만 반도체와 유가가 내리면 올해보다 줄 수도 있다며, 미국 데이터센터 사업 지연, 중국과의 경쟁, 보호무역주의를 위험 요인으로 들었어요. 산업부는 반도체와 석유화학의 가격 변동성, 미국과 유럽연합의 보호무역 확산, 공급 과잉 속 경쟁 심화도 경고했어요. 경제연구기관들은 기저효과로 2027년 수출 증가세가 둔화하겠지만 연간 수출은 1조 달러 안팎을 유지할 것으로 전망했어요. 산업연구원은 업종 간 불균형한 성장과 불안한 환율을 감안해 국내 산업 경쟁력을 지킬 방안이 필요하다고 촉구했어요.

sents.en: Kang expects chip exports to keep supporting overall shipments through at least the third quarter of 2027, citing demand from big technology firms building data centers.

sents.en: He said exports could top $1 trillion again next year, though easing chip and oil prices could pull them below this year's level, and he named delays in U.S. data center projects, Chinese competition and protectionism as risks.

sents.en: The ministry also warned of price volatility in chips and petrochemicals, rising protectionism in the U.S. and the European Union, and intensifying competition amid global oversupply.

paragraphs.en: Kang described the numbers as a sign of a structural shift: when exports first passed $10 billion in 1977 they were led by ships, frozen fish, plywood and clothing, while the AI build-out now creates markets for Korean power equipment, copper and aluminum alongside chips. He argued that Korea should rethink how it manages its surpluses, noting that Japan, Germany and China channeled theirs into overseas investment that now returns income home. "As an economy matures and costs rise, it cannot keep expanding production at home indefinitely," he said, adding that the export structure has to shift gradually toward investment. Asked whether Korea would follow Japan, which came to depend on overseas investment income after the 1985 Plaza Accord, he said a similar path is likely but that Korea should keep research and so-called mother factories at home. He framed overseas plants as a way to build strategic ties with partners wary of trade deficits, such as the U.S., because they create local jobs and buy from local suppliers, saying Korea "should not be a country that simply sells goods." To sustain growth beyond chips, the government says it will pursue stronger trade cooperation, a "stable and predictable" environment for exporters, and new sectors such as consumer goods, defense products and nuclear reactors.
paragraphs.ko: 강 차관은 이번 수치가 구조 변화의 신호라고 설명했어요. 1977년 수출이 처음 100억 달러를 넘을 때는 선박, 냉동 생선, 합판, 의류가 이끌었지만 이제는 AI 구축 붐이 반도체와 함께 전력기기, 구리, 알루미늄 시장을 만든다는 거예요. 그는 일본, 독일, 중국이 흑자를 해외 투자로 돌려 이제 그 수익이 본국으로 들어온다며, 한국도 흑자 관리 방식을 다시 생각해야 한다고 주장했어요. 그는 "경제가 성숙하고 비용이 오르면 국내 생산을 무한정 늘릴 수는 없다"며 수출 구조가 점차 투자로 옮겨가야 한다고 말했어요. 1985년 플라자 합의 뒤 해외 투자 수익에 기대게 된 일본을 따를지 묻자, 그는 비슷한 길을 갈 가능성이 크지만 연구와 이른바 '마더 팩토리'는 국내에 둬야 한다고 답했어요. 그는 해외 공장이 현지 일자리를 만들고 현지 협력사에서 구매하므로 미국처럼 무역적자에 민감한 파트너와 전략적 관계를 쌓는 방법이라며, 한국은 "단지 물건만 파는 나라여서는 안 된다"고 말했어요. 정부는 반도체 이후 성장을 이어가기 위해 무역 협력 강화, 수출 기업의 "안정적이고 예측 가능한" 환경, 소비재·방산·원전 같은 신산업 육성을 추진하겠다고 밝혔어요.

issues.titleKo: AI 부정행위 사건으로 수능에 대한 신뢰가 흔들리자 한국이 전례 없는 보안 속에서 수능을 치렀어요
issues.gist: More than 550,000 students sat South Korea's Suneung on Thursday under extraordinary security, after the top scorer on a tax accountant exam admitted cheating with a hidden camera and AI. Authorities checked glasses, taped over buttons and sent phone alerts to catch smuggled devices.
issues.gistKo: 목요일 55만 명이 넘는 학생이 전례 없는 보안 속에서 수능을 쳤어요. 세무사 시험 수석이 숨긴 카메라와 AI로 부정행위를 했다고 인정한 뒤였고, 당국은 안경을 검사하고 단추를 스티커로 가리고 긴급 재난 문자로 반입 기기를 찾았어요.
issues.easyKo: 세무사 시험에서 AI로 몰래 답을 얻은 사람이 있었다고 밝혀지자, 정부는 수능 때 스마트 기기를 철저히 막았어요. 안경과 단추를 검사하고 휴대전화를 찾는 큰 경보음도 울렸어요. 수능이 앞으로도 이대로여야 하느냐는 논쟁도 커졌어요.

views.view: The country's career-defining exam was thrown into doubt, and teachers' unions called the government response belated.
Authorities mounted all-out efforts to crack down on smart-device and AI cheating while many parents worried the checks could distract students.
Students and parents said the safeguards fell short but showed effort, and voiced resentment over the chaos.
Keeping devices out of exam rooms solves only the immediate problem; the scandal sharpens debate over what the Suneung measures in the AI era.
The exam proceeded in an almost dystopian atmosphere amid rampant fears of AI cheating and doubts about the integrity of the process.
Global experts urged embracing AI while investing in detection for high-stakes exams and rethinking how students are assessed.

talk.q: How should universities assess students fairly when AI can answer written exam questions?
talk.qKo: AI가 필기시험 문제를 풀 수 있을 때 대학은 학생을 어떻게 공정하게 평가해야 할까요?
talk.answer: After this scandal, I think strict device checks are necessary for high-stakes exams like the Suneung. In the longer run, universities could pay more attention to students' reasoning, as some experts suggested. I believe fairness should come first.
talk.answerKo: 이번 사건 뒤에 수능 같은 중요한 시험에는 엄격한 기기 검사가 필요하다고 생각해요. 길게 보면 일부 전문가가 제안했듯 대학이 학생의 추론 과정을 더 살필 수 있어요. 저는 공정성이 먼저라고 믿어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea staged its College Scholastic Ability Test, known as the Suneung, on Thursday under a degree of security never seen before, with 551,864 registered candidates sitting the exam at 1,312 test centers nationwide. The test, which ran from 8:40 a.m. to 5:45 p.m., is widely seen as a ticket to prestigious universities, well-paid jobs and even better marriage prospects in a fiercely competitive society. Authorities fielded about 75,000 proctors plus roughly 8,400 additional personnel, among them some 1,800 smart-device specialists and 6,600 hallway monitors, to head off any attempt to use artificial intelligence to cheat. The unusual precautions followed a scandal in which the top scorer on this year's certified tax accountant exam admitted cheating with a hidden camera and generative AI, a confession that raised doubts about whether the Suneung itself could be compromised.
paragraphs.ko: 대학수학능력시험(수능)이 목요일에 치러졌는데, 전에 없던 수준의 보안 속에서 등록 수험생 551,864명이 전국 1,312개 시험장에서 시험을 쳤어요. 오전 8시 40분부터 오후 5시 45분까지 이어진 이 시험은 경쟁이 치열한 사회에서 명문대, 높은 연봉의 직업, 심지어 더 좋은 결혼 조건으로 가는 입장권으로 널리 여겨져요. 당국은 감독관 약 7만 5천 명에 더해 추가 인력 약 8,400명을 투입했는데, 여기에는 스마트 기기 전문 요원 약 1,800명과 복도 감독관 6,600명이 포함돼요. 인공지능(AI)을 이용한 부정행위 시도를 막기 위해서예요. 이런 이례적인 대비는 올해 세무사 시험 수석 합격자가 숨긴 카메라와 생성형 AI로 부정행위를 했다고 털어놓은 사건 뒤에 나왔어요. 이 고백 때문에 수능 자체도 뚫릴 수 있다는 의문이 커졌어요.

paragraphs.en: The scandal broke on Sunday, when the man who topped the tax accountant exam, named by the Korea Herald as Han Won-seok, said in a video on his lawyer's YouTube channel that his result was not the product of honest effort. He said he had photographed the questions with a concealed micro-camera, fed them to an AI system and read the answers off a smartphone, and the Guardian noted that he missed only one of the 160 questions. He also admitted using the same method on a certified public accountant exam, which fed fears that AI-assisted cheating could be more widespread than thought and could have gone undetected in other tests. His lawyer handed police a camera, a laptop and a phone, and the Guardian reported that no charges had been brought, while the prime minister ordered procedures to void his result and bar him from the exam for five years. Allegations of AI-assisted cheating have also touched the Legal Education Eligibility Test, or LEET, which is used for law school admissions, the Korea Herald noted.

paragraphs.en: On Tuesday, Prime Minister Han Seong-sook announced a package of measures in a special address to the nation, calling AI-assisted cheating a "social evil" that the government would "root out." Smart phones, smart glasses, smartwatches, smart rings, ultracompact cameras, pens with built-in cameras and wireless earphones were all to be kept out of exam rooms or switched off and handed to proctors, and merely having one would count as cheating whether or not it had been used. Glasses were to be placed on desks and checked for AI features, buttons on clothing were to be covered with stickers to blind any miniature camera, and bags left in corridors would be watched for phones still switched on. The government said it would also block Wi-Fi inside exam venues and public Wi-Fi near schools, and would trace personal hotspots, which cannot be blocked, through connection records, while AFP reported that Wi-Fi was cut around exam halls. Officials also said they would work with global big tech firms in follow-up investigations if AI was suspected of having been used to solve questions captured in images of test papers.
paragraphs.ko: 화요일에 한성숙 국무총리는 대국민 특별 담화에서 대책을 발표하며, AI를 이용한 부정행위를 정부가 뿌리 뽑겠다고 한 '사회악'이라고 불렀어요. 스마트폰, 스마트 안경, 스마트워치, 스마트 반지, 초소형 카메라, 카메라가 든 필기구, 무선 이어폰은 모두 시험실에 가져가지 말거나 꺼서 감독관에게 내야 했어요. 지니고만 있어도 쓰지 않았더라도 부정행위로 봤어요. 안경은 책상 위에 올려 AI 기능이 있는지 검사했고, 초소형 카메라를 막으려고 옷의 단추는 스티커로 가렸어요. 복도에 둔 가방에 켜진 휴대전화가 있는지도 감시했어요. 정부는 시험장 안 와이파이와 학교 근처 공용 와이파이를 차단하고, 막을 수 없는 개인 핫스팟은 접속 기록으로 추적하겠다고 했어요. AFP는 시험장 주변 와이파이가 끊겼다고 전했어요. 당국은 시험지를 촬영한 이미지로 AI가 문제를 푼 것으로 의심되는 경우, 글로벌 빅테크 기업들과 협력해 후속 조사를 하겠다고도 했어요.

paragraphs.en: Han vowed that anyone caught would be barred from the CSAT for 10 years, face criminal punishment and lose any university place won through cheating, with enrolled students expelled if misconduct came to light after the exam. She said serious misconduct would be treated as obstruction of official duties through deceptive means, going beyond simply invalidating a score. The government also said it would immediately introduce a reward of up to 100 million won, about $75,000, for people who report cheating, and would revise laws to impose the 10-year ban, a step the ruling Democratic Party said on Monday it would pursue through legislation. Those caught could face criminal charges carrying a prison term of up to five years, and the government planned to launch a task force led by the prime minister on Friday, a day after the exam, to crack down further. Han wrote on X on Monday that checks would be handled carefully so that candidates acting in good faith would not suffer unnecessary anxiety or inconvenience.
paragraphs.ko: 한 총리는 적발된 사람은 수능 응시를 10년간 제한하고 형사 처벌하며, 부정행위로 얻은 대학 입학을 취소하고, 시험 뒤에 드러나면 재학생도 퇴학시키겠다고 다짐했어요. 그는 심각한 부정행위는 단순히 성적을 무효로 하는 데서 그치지 않고 위계에 의한 공무집행방해로 다루겠다고 말했어요. 정부는 부정행위를 신고하면 최대 1억 원, 약 7만 5천 달러의 포상금을 곧바로 도입하고 10년 응시 제한을 위해 법을 고치겠다고도 했어요. 여당인 민주당은 월요일에 입법을 추진하겠다고 밝혔어요. 적발된 사람은 최대 징역 5년이 가능한 형사 혐의를 받을 수 있고, 정부는 시험 다음 날인 금요일에 총리가 이끄는 태스크포스를 띄워 단속을 더 이어가겠다고 했어요. 한 총리는 월요일 엑스(X)에 성실하게 시험을 치르는 수험생이 불필요한 불안이나 불편을 겪지 않도록 검사를 신중하게 하겠다고 썼어요.

paragraphs.en: Many people had called for the exam to be postponed, but Vice Education Minister Choi Eun-ok said on Tuesday that the government would not delay it, because a postponement would last at most one to two weeks and officials judged that the confusion for test-takers and disruption to admissions would be greater. She added that officials had weighed other risks, such as possible leaks of exam papers that were already being distributed to test sites. Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin told lawmakers on Monday that rescheduling would cause greater confusion, and he conceded that while smart glasses already on sale could be screened out, newer variants could not be dealt with perfectly. The exam has been postponed before, including in 2017 after an earthquake struck the south-eastern city of Pohang and in 2020 because of the Covid pandemic. A 50-year-old parent of a high school senior told Yonhap that the test should wait even a few days so detection devices could be prepared, and the exam agency's website was flooded with posts demanding action and a delay.
paragraphs.ko: 많은 사람이 시험 연기를 요구했지만, 최은옥 교육부 차관은 화요일에 연기해도 최대 한두 주이고 수험생의 혼란과 입시 차질이 더 클 것으로 판단했다며 연기하지 않겠다고 밝혔어요. 그는 시험지가 이미 시험장으로 배송되고 있어 유출될 위험 같은 다른 위험도 따져 봤다고 덧붙였어요. 최교진 교육부 장관은 월요일 국회에서 일정을 바꾸면 혼란이 더 커진다고 말했고, 이미 시판 중인 스마트 안경은 걸러낼 수 있지만 더 새로운 제품은 완벽하게 대응할 수 없다고 인정했어요. 수능은 전에도 연기된 적이 있어요. 2017년에는 남동부 도시 포항에 지진이 나서, 2020년에는 코로나19 때문에 미뤄졌어요. 고3 수험생의 50세 학부모는 연합뉴스에 탐지 장비를 준비하도록 며칠만이라도 미뤄야 한다고 말했고, 수능을 주관하는 기관의 누리집에는 대책과 연기를 요구하는 글이 몰렸어요.

paragraphs.en: Smart glasses have been banned from exams since the end of June, and several candidates were caught with them in October during university-run admissions tests, while at the Suneung wearing a pair counts as using one even when it is switched off, the Guardian reported. The education ministry looked at radio-frequency equipment to detect such glasses but concluded that conditions varied too much between venues to deploy it this year, so checks relied on visual inspection, with at least one dedicated official in each test center. Teachers' unions criticized the response as belated, citing a survey of 2,716 secondary school teachers by the Korean Teachers and Education Workers Union in which 82.3% said they could not tell whether a candidate was wearing smart glasses under the current procedure and only 3.5% said they could. Some candidates reportedly switched to contact lenses, and an optician in Suwon said students who had never worn them were coming in to ask how to put them in.
paragraphs.ko: 스마트 안경은 6월 말부터 시험에서 금지됐고, 10월 대학별 입학 시험에서 몇몇 수험생이 적발됐어요. 가디언에 따르면 수능에서는 꺼져 있어도 쓰고 있으면 사용한 것으로 쳐요. 교육부는 이런 안경을 찾을 무선 주파수 장비를 검토했지만 시험장마다 조건이 너무 달라 올해는 쓰기 어렵다고 결론 냈어요. 그래서 육안 검사에 의존했고 시험장마다 전담 요원을 한 명 이상 뒀어요. 교원단체들은 정부 대응이 늦었다고 비판했어요. 전국교직원노동조합이 중등 교사 2,716명에게 한 조사에서 82.3%는 현재 절차로는 수험생이 스마트 안경을 썼는지 알 수 없다고 했고 알 수 있다는 응답은 3.5%뿐이었어요. 일부 수험생은 렌즈로 바꿨다고 전해졌고, 수원의 한 안경사는 렌즈를 써 본 적 없는 학생들이 끼는 법을 물으러 온다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Smart glasses have been banned from exams since the end of June, and several candidates were caught with them in October during university-run admissions tests, while at the Suneung wearing a pair counts as using one even when it is switched off, the Guardian reported.

sents.en: The education ministry looked at radio-frequency equipment to detect such glasses but concluded that conditions varied too much between venues to deploy it this year, so checks relied on visual inspection, with at least one dedicated official in each test center.

paragraphs.en: To catch phones that had not been handed in, the government planned an emergency alert, built to reach nearly every mobile phone and sound a loud alarm even when muted, at 8:30 a.m., shortly before the test began. On Wednesday the interior ministry said a second alert would go out at an undisclosed time during the exam, and that each alert would ring for 10.5 seconds at full volume. President Lee Jae Myung, who was attending the ASEAN summit in Manila and chaired an anti-cheating meeting by video link, said he had told officials to consider sending random alerts during the exam. Worried that the alarms could rattle test-takers, he said in a post on X that he had instructed the government to consider extending the exam end time by the amount of time lost if a device went off and a proctor had to remove a test-taker, adding that the necessary steps should take just two to three minutes unless there were multiple cheating cases. Separately, the education ministry told schools that only pencils could be brought into exam rooms, with other stationery supplied at the sites, apparently out of concern about miniature cameras hidden in personal items.
paragraphs.ko: 제출하지 않은 휴대전화를 찾아내려고 정부는 거의 모든 휴대전화에 닿고 무음이어도 큰 소리가 나는 긴급 재난 문자를 시험 시작 직전인 오전 8시 30분에 보내기로 했어요. 수요일에 행정안전부는 시험 중 공개하지 않은 시각에 두 번째 경보를 보내며, 경보는 각각 최대 음량으로 10.5초간 울린다고 밝혔어요. 마닐라에서 아세안 정상회의에 참석 중이던 이재명 대통령은 화상으로 부정행위 방지 회의를 주재하며, 시험 중 무작위 경보를 보내는 방안을 검토하라고 지시했다고 밝혔어요. 그는 경보가 수험생을 흔들 수 있다고 걱정하며 엑스에 글을 올렸어요. 기기가 울려 감독관이 수험생을 퇴실시켜야 하면 잃은 시간만큼 종료 시각을 늘리는 방안을 검토하라고 지시했고, 부정행위가 여럿이 아니라면 필요한 조치는 2~3분이면 된다고 덧붙였어요. 별도로 교육부는 학교들에 시험실에는 연필만 가져갈 수 있고 다른 문구류는 시험장에서 제공한다고 알렸어요. 개인 소지품에 초소형 카메라를 숨길 수 있다는 우려를 반영한 것으로 보여요.

paragraphs.en: On the day itself, the alert sounded about ten minutes before the exam, according to KBS World Radio, and two more alarms went off later in the day. At least 22 test-takers were caught with phones, and police found a miniature camera and an earphone at an exam site in Yongin, outside Seoul, KBS reported, adding that more allegations emerged afterward. Vice Education Minister Choi said the unauthorized devices turned up in nine cities and provinces but the exam went ahead without delay, and she warned that cheaters would face charges of obstructing official duties by fraudulent means. Outside a Seoul high school, 18-year-old test-taker Yoon Seong-hwan said he wore contact lenses instead of his usual glasses because he felt uneasy about being checked, and Lee Jeong-ok said she took every button off her son's clothes at his request. As is tradition, the country adjusted daily life for the exam: takeoffs and landings were banned from 1:05 p.m. to 1:40 p.m. during the English listening section, with aircraft already airborne required to stay at 3 kilometers or higher, and Seoul added 27 subway runs. The local stock market, which normally opens at 9 a.m. and closes at 3:30 p.m., opened and closed an hour later to ease the morning rush hour.
paragraphs.ko: KBS 월드라디오에 따르면 시험 당일 경보는 시험 10분쯤 전에 울렸고, 하루 중 두 번의 경보가 더 울렸어요. KBS는 최소 22명의 수험생이 휴대전화를 갖고 있다 적발됐고, 서울 바깥 용인의 한 시험장에서 경찰이 초소형 카메라와 이어폰을 찾았다고 전했어요. 그 뒤로 의혹이 더 나왔다고도 했어요. 최 차관은 허용되지 않은 기기가 9개 시·도에서 나왔지만 시험은 지연 없이 진행됐다고 말했고, 부정행위자는 위계에 의한 공무집행방해 혐의를 받을 것이라고 경고했어요. 서울의 한 고등학교 앞에서 18세 수험생 윤성환 군은 검사받는 것이 불안해 평소 쓰던 안경 대신 렌즈를 꼈다고 말했어요. 이정옥 씨는 아들이 부탁해서 옷의 단추를 모두 뗐다고 했어요. 전통대로 나라는 일상을 수능에 맞춰 조정했어요. 영어 듣기 시간인 오후 1시 5분부터 1시 40분까지 항공기 이착륙을 금지했고, 이미 떠 있는 항공기는 고도 3킬로미터 이상을 유지해야 했어요. 서울은 지하철을 27회 늘려 운행했어요. 보통 오전 9시에 열어 오후 3시 30분에 닫는 국내 증시는 아침 출근 혼잡을 덜려고 한 시간씩 늦게 열고 닫았어요.

paragraphs.en: The Guardian noted the lengths the country routinely goes to for the exam, including rescheduling flights and suspending artillery fire and tank movements during the 25-minute English listening paper. Cars are stopped 200 meters from every center, extra trains run from 6 a.m., police drive latecomers to their exam halls, tourist attractions open late and offices are asked to open at 10 a.m. Behind the scenes, around 500 test writers and reviewers and about 280 administrative staff were sequestered at an undisclosed facility from early to mid-October, according to the Korea Institute for Curriculum and Evaluation, and were due to be released after the exam ended at 5:45 p.m. They were barred from leaving or using smartphones, tablets and Bluetooth earphones, and they also had to prepare a backup set of questions in case a disaster forced a postponement.
paragraphs.ko: 가디언은 나라가 수능을 위해 평소에도 얼마나 애쓰는지 짚었어요. 25분짜리 영어 듣기 평가 동안 항공편 일정을 바꾸고 포 사격과 전차 이동을 멈춘다고 해요. 차량은 시험장마다 200미터 앞에서 멈추고, 추가 열차가 오전 6시부터 다니며, 경찰이 지각생을 시험장까지 태워 주고, 관광지는 늦게 열고, 사무실은 오전 10시에 문을 열도록 요청받아요. 한국교육과정평가원에 따르면 출제·검토 위원 약 500명과 행정 인력 약 280명이 10월 초중순부터 공개되지 않은 시설에서 격리 생활을 했고, 시험이 끝나는 오후 5시 45분 이후 풀려날 예정이었어요. 이들은 시설을 떠나거나 스마트폰, 태블릿, 블루투스 이어폰을 쓸 수 없었고, 재난으로 시험이 미뤄질 경우에 대비해 예비 문제 한 벌도 만들어야 했어요.

paragraphs.en: Students and parents interviewed by the Korea Times said the government's measures fell short but showed effort, and several voiced resentment at the chaos. Shin Ha-seong, a high school senior, feared being wrongly suspected because of his horn-rimmed glasses and said he had heard some people were switching to metal frames, and he guessed the government refused to postpone because a delay would only mean more cheaters. Yong Ye-jun, 18, said the rules changed abruptly one after another, leaving him scrambling over what to pack, while Hyun Bin doubted that the measures had reassured students. Park Hae-suk, 49, called herself furious and deeply worried but said the government moved fast once the problem came to light, and Oh Yu-sun, 50, said she avoided the news to protect her child's routine. Oh said she was disappointed by Education Minister Choi's reply of "I don't think I can" when asked in the National Assembly whether he could assure detecting 100 percent of AI-assisted cheating, and by Democratic Party Rep. Kim Moon-soo's remark that test-takers might have to act as proctors for one another.

sents.en: Yong Ye-jun, 18, said the rules changed abruptly one after another, leaving him scrambling over what to pack, while Hyun Bin doubted that the measures had reassured students.

paragraphs.en: The scandal has also revived a debate over what the Suneung measures at all when AI can answer the same questions, the Korea Herald reported. Park Do-soon, who helped introduce the exam in 1993 and became the first director of the Korea Institute for Curriculum and Evaluation, argued that a written exam tests only about one-tenth of curricular goals and urged giving universities primary responsibility for assessing applicants. Cho Byeok, a chair professor at Korea University, has called for abolishing the Suneung, saying students need to learn only about half of what is now taught from elementary through high school, and he predicted major changes in the education system within five years. The Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education had already proposed, in a December 2025 roadmap, to begin changes in 2028 with a greater role for essay-based assessment and to phase out the Suneung by the 2040 academic year. The national government has yet to adopt the plan, and the Seoul office cannot change the nationwide admissions system on its own. In a country where more than 70 percent of high school students go on to higher education, such a shift would put more decisions about what to assess and how in the hands of individual universities.
paragraphs.ko: 코리아헤럴드는 이번 사건이 AI가 같은 문제를 풀 수 있는 시대에 수능이 도대체 무엇을 재는가 하는 논쟁을 되살렸다고 전했어요. 1993년 수능 도입에 참여하고 한국교육과정평가원 초대 원장이 된 박도순 씨는 필기시험이 교육과정 목표의 약 10분의 1만 잴 수 있다고 주장하며, 지원자 평가의 일차 책임을 대학에 맡기라고 촉구했어요. 고려대 석좌교수 조벽 씨는 수능을 없애자고 주장해 왔어요. 학생은 지금 초등학교부터 고등학교까지 가르치는 것의 절반만 배우면 된다고 했고, 5년 안에 교육 제도에 큰 변화가 올 것이라고 내다봤어요. 서울시교육청은 이미 2025년 12월 로드맵에서 2028년부터 변화를 시작해 논술형 평가의 비중을 키우고 2040학년도까지 수능을 단계적으로 없애자고 제안했어요. 중앙정부는 이 계획을 아직 채택하지 않았고, 서울시교육청이 전국 입시 제도를 혼자 바꿀 수는 없어요. 고등학생의 70% 넘게 대학에 진학하는 나라에서, 이런 변화는 무엇을 어떻게 평가할지에 대한 결정을 개별 대학의 손에 더 많이 넘기게 돼요.

paragraphs.en: Global higher-education experts in Seoul for the Times Higher Education Innovation & Impact Summit 2026 at Korea University told the Korea Times that universities should embrace AI while high-stakes exams invest in detection. Kuancheng Huang of National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University in Taiwan said the technology to counter ever more sophisticated cheating devices exists, making it largely a question of how much authorities are willing to spend, and he urged shifting assessment toward students' reasoning and problem-solving. John Kao, president of National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan, said cheating has been around since the beginning of time and that banning tools would not stop cheaters, so the emphasis should be on academic ethics, and his university requires students and faculty to disclose their use of AI much like citing sources. Dawn Freshwater, executive director of the Worldwide Universities Network, said students will live in a world immersed in AI and should be taught critical thinking and ethical judgment so they use it responsibly.
paragraphs.ko: 고려대에서 열린 타임스고등교육 혁신·임팩트 서밋 2026 참석차 서울을 찾은 세계 고등교육 전문가들은 코리아타임스에, 대학은 AI를 받아들이되 중요한 시험은 탐지 기술에 투자해야 한다고 말했어요. 대만 국립양밍자오퉁대의 황콴청 교수는 점점 정교해지는 부정행위 기기에 맞설 기술은 이미 있어서 결국 당국이 얼마나 돈을 쓰느냐의 문제라고 했고, 평가를 학생의 추론과 문제 해결 과정 쪽으로 옮기라고 촉구했어요. 대만 국립칭화대의 존 카오 총장은 부정행위는 태초부터 있었고 도구를 금지해도 부정행위자는 막을 수 없으니 학문적 윤리를 강조해야 한다고 했어요. 그의 대학은 출처를 밝히듯 학생과 교수가 AI 사용을 공개하도록 해요. 세계대학네트워크(WUN)의 돈 프레시워터 사무총장은 학생들이 AI에 둘러싸인 세상에서 살 것이므로 책임 있게 쓰도록 비판적 사고와 윤리적 판단을 가르쳐야 한다고 했어요.

choices: He bribed a proctor to leak the questions

Independent evaluators rank it third overall on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, behind Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra.

views.view: Neon is likely Google's Claude Opus or Sol equivalent, and it is the fourth new Gemini 4 model in four weeks.
Midtier models perform so alike that many firms may find Neon's slight edge too small to justify its higher price than GPT-6.2 Sol.
Neon rivals Carbon across coding, reasoning and agentic tasks at Flash speeds and lower cost, though the model names are hard to keep up with.
Neon is a strong performer in the top three on multiple benchmarks and, unlike Carbon, reaches AI Pro plans, lowering the bar for entry.
Independent evaluators Arena and Vals AI confirm Neon's strong debut, ranking it second on their agent and Vals indexes.

talk.answer: I would first compare cost per task, because Google says Neon costs far less per task than Carbon. Midtier models perform so similarly that a small edge may not justify a higher price. I would pick the one that finishes my real work cheaply.

paragraphs.en: Google released Gemini 4 Neon on Wednesday, its fourth new Gemini 4 model in a matter of weeks, billing it as frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across software engineering, knowledge work and science. The model slots between Carbon, the flagship built for the hardest long-horizon projects, and Hydrogen, the cheaper tier designed for fast everyday execution, and it replaces Argon for paying subscribers in the Gemini app. According to 9to5Google, the older 3.1 Pro is finally being retired as part of the shuffle, while 3.5 Flash-Lite becomes the "Auto" option in the model picker for paid users. Neon accepts text, images, video, audio and PDFs, carries a context window of about one million tokens and can produce up to one million tokens of output, though it cannot generate images or audio. It supports computer use, code execution, file search and grounding through Google Search and Maps, and it offers four thinking levels, from low to extra high, so teams can trade intelligence against token spend.
paragraphs.ko: 구글이 수요일에 제미나이 4 네온을 내놓았어요. 몇 주 사이에 나온 네 번째 제미나이 4 모델이고, 소프트웨어 개발·지식 업무·과학 전반에서 최전선 수준의 지능과 빠른 작업 완료를 내세워요. 이 모델은 가장 어려운 장기 프로젝트용 주력 모델인 카본과 빠른 일상 작업용 저가 모델인 하이드로젠 사이에 놓이고, 제미나이 앱에서는 유료 구독자에게 아르곤을 대신해요. 9to5Google에 따르면 이번 개편으로 옛 3.1 프로가 마침내 사라지고, 3.5 플래시-라이트는 유료 이용자의 모델 선택기에서 "자동" 항목이 돼요. 네온은 텍스트·이미지·영상·음성·PDF를 받아들이고, 약 100만 토큰의 컨텍스트 창을 갖추며 최대 100만 토큰까지 출력할 수 있지만 이미지나 음성은 만들지 못해요. 컴퓨터 사용, 코드 실행, 파일 검색, 구글 검색과 지도를 통한 근거 연결을 지원하고, 낮음부터 매우 높음까지 네 가지 사고 단계가 있어 팀이 지능과 토큰 비용을 맞바꿀 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: Neon went live through the paid API at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with cached input at $0.15, which is twice the price of Hydrogen at $1.50 and $7.50. Carbon and Argon carry an introductory rate of $2 and $10 that is due to double to $4 and $20 once the promotion ends, which would leave Neon about 25 percent cheaper than Carbon, according to 9to5Google. SiliconANGLE placed that pricing squarely between OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol, at $2 and $10, and Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, at $4 and $20. Google says Neon finishes most tasks about three times as fast as Carbon at roughly 60 percent lower cost, and TestingCatalog reported that at the default high setting the company puts the saving at 32 percent per task.
paragraphs.ko: 네온은 유료 API로 입력 100만 토큰당 3달러, 출력 100만 토큰당 15달러에 공개됐고 캐시된 입력은 0.15달러예요. 이는 1.50달러와 7.50달러인 하이드로젠의 두 배예요. 카본과 아르곤은 도입 요금이 2달러와 10달러이고 프로모션이 끝나면 4달러와 20달러로 두 배가 되는데, 9to5Google에 따르면 그렇게 되면 네온은 카본보다 약 25퍼센트 저렴해져요. 실리콘앵글은 이 가격이 오픈AI의 GPT-6.2 솔(2달러와 10달러)과 앤스로픽의 클로드 오퍼스 5.5(4달러와 20달러) 사이에 정확히 놓인다고 짚었어요. 구글은 네온이 대부분의 작업을 카본보다 약 세 배 빠르게, 약 60퍼센트 낮은 비용으로 끝낸다고 말하고, 테스팅카탈로그는 기본 높음 설정에서 작업당 절감폭을 32퍼센트로 잡는다고 전했어요.

paragraphs.en: In benchmarks that Google published itself, Neon outpaced Carbon on some tasks and beat the midtier Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol on knowledge work, reasoning, automation, multimodal understanding, cybersecurity, science and math. It scored 65.4 percent on CursorBench 4.1 against 58.1 percent for Opus 5.5, 65.2 percent on Terminal-Bench 4.1 and 39.0 percent on SWE-sweep inside Antigravity, and Google cited 46.2 percent on FrontierCode 2.0 at the default setting. The company also claimed first place on most benchmarks covering finance, accounting, spreadsheet modeling and complex constraint following, second place on steerability, and 73.5 percent on a test of reading dense professional charts.
paragraphs.ko: 구글이 직접 공개한 벤치마크에서 네온은 일부 작업에서 카본을 앞섰고 지식 업무·추론·자동화·멀티모달 이해·사이버 보안·과학·수학에서 중간급 클로드 오퍼스 5.5와 GPT-6.2 솔을 이겼어요. 커서벤치 4.1에서 65.4퍼센트로 오퍼스 5.5의 58.1퍼센트를 앞섰고, 터미널벤치 4.1에서 65.2퍼센트, 안티그래비티 안의 SWE-스윕에서 39.0퍼센트를 기록했으며, 구글은 기본 설정의 프론티어코드 2.0에서 46.2퍼센트도 내세웠어요. 회사는 또 재무·회계·스프레드시트 모델링·복잡한 제약 조건 따르기를 다루는 대부분의 벤치마크에서 1위, 조정 가능성에서 2위, 빽빽한 전문 차트 읽기 시험에서 73.5퍼센트를 차지했다고 주장했어요.

paragraphs.en: Outside evaluators were more measured but still favorable, with Artificial Analysis giving Neon a score of 61 on its Intelligence Index at the highest thinking level, third overall behind Claude Fable 5.2 at 65 and GPT-6.2 Astra at 62. The same firm said Neon delivered a small intelligence gain over Carbon at about 17 percent lower cost per task and topped its Coding Agent Index at 58.6. Vals AI put Neon second on its Vals Index at 70.9 percent, 0.4 points behind Fable 5.2 at less than half the cost per task, and first on its finance and legal indexes. Arena said Neon debuted second on its new Agent Arena Index with 1,336 points from about 4,200 real-world agent sessions, at a median cost of $2.82 per task, 53 percent less than Opus 5.5, while Google now holds the top three spots in its Text Arena, with Neon third at 1,518.
paragraphs.ko: 외부 평가 기관들은 더 신중했지만 여전히 호의적이었어요. 아티피셜 애널리시스는 최고 사고 단계의 네온에 지능 지수 61점을 줘, 65점의 클로드 파블 5.2와 62점의 GPT-6.2 아스트라에 이어 전체 3위로 평가했어요. 같은 회사는 네온이 카본보다 지능이 조금 높으면서 작업당 비용은 약 17퍼센트 낮고, 코딩 에이전트 지수에서 58.6점으로 1위라고 밝혔어요. 발스 AI는 네온을 발스 지수 70.9퍼센트로 2위에 올렸는데, 작업당 비용이 절반도 안 되면서 파블 5.2에 0.4점 뒤질 뿐이고 금융·법률 지수에서는 1위라고 했어요. 아레나는 네온이 약 4,200건의 실제 에이전트 세션에서 1,336점으로 새 에이전트 아레나 지수 2위로 데뷔했고, 작업당 중앙값 비용 2.82달러는 오퍼스 5.5보다 53퍼센트 낮다고 했어요. 텍스트 아레나에서는 구글이 1~3위를 차지했고 네온은 1,518점으로 3위예요.

paragraphs.en: Google is offering Neon in the Gemini app to AI Pro and AI Ultra subscribers, whereas Android Authority noted that Carbon had been limited to Ultra accounts, which drastically lowers the bar for entry. Developers can reach it through the paid tier of the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, in Google Antigravity for paid Pro and Ultra users, and through business offerings, while eligible members of the Fairwind Program will receive a cyber defense version within days. In the app, Neon now powers Tasks, which handle multistep jobs such as analyzing billing statements to find out why a utility charge spiked or cross-checking receipts to negotiate a refund, and in Antigravity it can act as an orchestrator directing parallel Hydrogen subagents. Google adds that Neon keeps Carbon-level protections against severe misuse and prompt injection while declining far less legitimate work, and that it recorded the lowest fabrication rate yet in internal Antigravity testing.
paragraphs.ko: 구글은 네온을 제미나이 앱의 AI 프로와 AI 울트라 구독자에게 내놓았어요. 안드로이드 오소리티는 카본이 울트라 계정에만 한정됐었다며 진입 문턱이 크게 낮아졌다고 했어요. 개발자는 구글 AI 스튜디오와 안드로이드 스튜디오의 제미나이 API 유료 단계, 유료 프로·울트라 이용자용 구글 안티그래비티, 기업용 상품으로 쓸 수 있고, 자격이 되는 페어윈드 프로그램 회원은 며칠 안에 사이버 방어용 버전을 받아요. 앱에서 네온은 이제 작업 기능을 구동해요. 공과금이 왜 급증했는지 청구서를 분석하거나 영수증을 교차 확인해 환불을 협상하는 식의 여러 단계 일을 맡고, 안티그래비티에서는 병렬 하이드로젠 하위 에이전트를 지휘하는 조율자 역할도 해요. 구글은 네온이 심각한 오용과 프롬프트 주입에 대한 카본 수준의 방어를 유지하면서도 정당한 요청은 훨씬 덜 거절하고, 내부 안티그래비티 시험에서 지금까지 가장 낮은 조작 응답 비율을 기록했다고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: SiliconANGLE framed the launch as Google hitting back after laying low over the summer while Anthropic and OpenAI unleashed powerful new frontier models, noting that Neon beat Carbon on certain tasks even though Carbon is billed as the company's strongest. It cautioned that these midtier models perform so similarly that cost efficiency is becoming a bigger factor for enterprise customers, and that many organizations may judge Neon's slight edge too small to justify paying more than for GPT-6.2 Sol. The Decoder suggested that if Carbon and Argon are Google's counterparts to OpenAI's Astra or Anthropic's Fable, Neon is likely its equivalent of Claude Opus or Sol, and it said fuller benchmarks should follow within hours. A commenter on 9to5Google grumbled that it is getting hard to keep up with names like Argon, Hydrogen, Carbon and Neon, a complaint that also applies to the naming schemes of rival labs.
paragraphs.ko: 실리콘앵글은 이번 출시를 구글의 반격으로 봤어요. 여름 내내 잠잠한 사이 앤스로픽과 오픈AI가 강력한 새 최전선 모델을 쏟아냈고, 카본이 가장 강하다고 소개됐는데도 네온이 일부 작업에서 카본을 앞섰다고 짚었죠. 이 매체는 중간급 모델들의 성능이 비슷해 기업 고객에게는 비용 효율이 점점 더 큰 요소가 되고 있고, 많은 조직이 네온의 근소한 우위가 GPT-6.2 솔보다 더 낼 만큼은 아니라고 판단할 수 있다고 경고했어요. 더 디코더는 카본과 아르곤이 오픈AI의 아스트라나 앤스로픽의 파블에 해당한다면 네온은 클로드 오퍼스나 솔에 해당할 것 같다고 했고, 더 자세한 벤치마크가 몇 시간 안에 나올 것이라고 했어요. 9to5Google의 한 독자는 아르곤·하이드로젠·카본·네온 같은 이름을 따라가기 어렵다고 투덜댔는데, 이는 경쟁사들의 이름 체계에도 해당하는 불만이에요.

issues.title: US Loses Measles Elimination Status After 26 Years as Outbreak Hits Worst Level Since 1991
issues.titleKo: 미국이 1991년 이후 최악의 홍역 유행 속에서 26년 만에 홍역 퇴치 인정을 잃어요
issues.gist: The Pan American Health Organization has ruled that measles is endemic again in the United States, Mexico and Bolivia, stripping the US of the elimination status it held since 2000. The decision comes amid more than 5,400 US cases this year, the most since 1991.
issues.gistKo: 범미보건기구는 미국, 멕시코, 볼리비아에서 홍역이 다시 토착화했다고 판단해, 미국이 2000년부터 지녀 온 퇴치 인정을 박탈했어요. 올해 미국 환자는 5,400명을 넘어 1991년 이후 가장 많아요.
issues.easyKo: 미국에서 홍역이 1년 넘게 끊기지 않고 퍼져서 "홍역이 없는 나라"라는 공식 인정을 잃었어요. 접종률이 떨어진 탓이 크고, 펜실베이니아에서는 어른 환자도 많아요. 이름뿐인 지위지만 대응을 다시 세워야 한다는 경고예요.

paragraphs.en: The United States has formally lost its measles elimination status, ending a run of 26 years in which the highly contagious virus was considered no longer native to the country. The Pan American Health Organization, the regional arm of the World Health Organization, announced the decision on Tuesday, Nov. 17, and ruled that Mexico and Bolivia had also forfeited their status. In effect, the agency concluded that measles is once again endemic in all three countries, meaning it now spreads continuously from person to person rather than arriving only with travelers. The announcement arrives as the US endures its worst outbreak since 1991, with more than 5,400 confirmed cases reported so far this year, according to The Guardian, the Associated Press and Ars Technica. Nature put the figure at more than 5,700 infections and 10 deaths, and tallies of the dead vary by outlet, from six to 10, reflecting how quickly the numbers are changing.
paragraphs.ko: 미국이 공식적으로 홍역 퇴치 인정을 잃었어요. 전염성이 매우 강한 이 바이러스가 더는 자국 내에서 퍼지지 않는 것으로 인정받던 26년이 끝났어요. 세계보건기구(WHO)의 미주 지역 기구인 범미보건기구(PAHO)가 11월 17일 화요일 이 결정을 발표했고, 멕시코와 볼리비아도 같은 지위를 잃었다고 판단했어요. 사실상 PAHO는 세 나라 모두에서 홍역이 다시 토착화했다고 결론 내렸어요. 즉 여행객이 들여올 때만이 아니라 사람 사이에서 계속 퍼진다는 뜻이에요. 이번 발표는 미국이 1991년 이후 최악의 유행을 겪는 가운데 나왔어요. 가디언, AP 통신, 아스 테크니카에 따르면 올해 확진자는 지금까지 5,400명을 넘었어요. 네이처는 감염자를 5,700명 넘게, 사망자를 10명으로 전했어요. 사망자 수는 언론사마다 6명에서 10명까지 달라서, 수치가 그만큼 빠르게 바뀌고 있음을 보여 줘요.

sents.en: Nature put the figure at more than 5,700 infections and 10 deaths, and tallies of the dead vary by outlet, from six to 10, reflecting how quickly the numbers are changing.
sents.ko: 네이처는 감염자를 5,700명 넘게, 사망자를 10명으로 전했어요. 사망자 수는 언론사마다 6명에서 10명까지 달라서, 수치가 그만큼 빠르게 바뀌고 있음을 보여 줘요.

paragraphs.en: Under the criteria used by PAHO's independent verification panel, a country forfeits elimination when the same virus genotype and lineage circulate without interruption for 12 months or longer. The panel, known as the Regional Monitoring and Re-Verification Commission, met from Nov. 10 to 13 and reviewed evidence from all 47 reporting countries and territories in the Americas. Its recommendations were accepted by PAHO's director, Dr. Jarbas Barbosa, who made the final call on the American case. According to a PAHO Q&A, the American chain began on Jan. 20, 2025, and crossed the 12-month line on Jan. 20, 2026; Mexico's began on Feb. 1, 2025, and Bolivia's on April 16, 2025. The first date corresponds to the West Texas outbreak, which was declared over on Aug. 18, 2025, after 762 confirmed cases in that state, but the virus kept moving elsewhere.
paragraphs.ko: PAHO 독립 검증위원회의 기준에 따르면, 같은 유전형과 계통의 바이러스가 12개월 이상 끊기지 않고 돌면 그 나라는 퇴치 인정을 잃어요. 지역 모니터링·재검증위원회라는 이 기구는 11월 10일부터 13일까지 회의를 열어 미주의 보고 대상 47개 나라와 지역의 자료를 살펴봤어요. 위원회의 권고는 PAHO 사무총장인 자르바스 바르보사 박사가 받아들였고, 미국 사례의 최종 결정도 그가 내렸어요. PAHO의 질의응답 문서에 따르면 미국의 전파 고리는 2025년 1월 20일에 시작해 2026년 1월 20일에 12개월을 넘겼어요. 멕시코는 2025년 2월 1일, 볼리비아는 2025년 4월 16일에 시작됐어요. 첫 날짜는 서부 텍사스 유행과 맞아떨어져요. 이 유행은 그 주에서 762명이 확진된 뒤 2025년 8월 18일 종료가 선언됐지만, 바이러스는 다른 곳에서 계속 움직였어요.

paragraphs.en: Ars Technica noted a striking wrinkle: PAHO examined only the period from January 2025 to January 2026, so this year's explosive Pennsylvania outbreak played no part in the ruling. "The number of cases in Pennsylvania did not actually contribute to the decision," PAHO assistant director Rhonda Sealey-Thomas told reporters, while the US logged 2,289 cases nationally in 2025. Noel Brewer, a University of North Carolina public health professor who chairs the US committee that presented the data, said there were several genetically distinct introductions but one lineage tied most cases together. He added that one or two lineages may have run past 12 months, and that the full dataset remains private until the CDC approves its release.
paragraphs.ko: 아스 테크니카는 눈에 띄는 대목을 짚었어요. PAHO가 2025년 1월부터 2026년 1월까지만 살폈기 때문에, 올해 폭발적으로 번진 펜실베이니아 유행은 이번 판정에 반영되지 않았다는 거예요. PAHO의 론다 실리토머스 부국장은 기자들에게 "펜실베이니아의 환자 수는 실제로 결정에 영향을 주지 않았다"고 말했어요. 2025년 미국 전체 환자는 2,289명이었어요. 미국 쪽 자료를 발표한 위원회의 위원장인 노스캐롤라이나대 보건학 교수 노엘 브루어는, 유전적으로 구별되는 유입이 여러 번 있었지만 대부분의 환자를 잇는 계통이 하나 있다고 말했어요. 그는 한두 개 계통은 12개월을 넘겼을 수 있다고 덧붙였고, 전체 자료는 CDC가 공개를 승인할 때까지 비공개라고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: Since the US declared measles eliminated in 2000, when it recorded 85 cases, officials typically logged fewer than 200 a year, most of them tied to international travel, the AP reported. Pennsylvania's outbreak, which began in April, has since dwarfed earlier ones, with at least 1,561 cases, 1,055 of them in adults, and fewer than 1% of those infected fully vaccinated, Ars Technica reported. CIDRAP counted at least seven measles deaths in that state, and said state health departments had reported 13 deaths across 2025 and 2026 combined. Earlier outbreaks included a South Carolina cluster that sickened 997 people before it ended in April, plus flare-ups in New Mexico, Arizona and Utah. The AP said all but three states have confirmed a case this year, and that 2026 is already running at roughly double the 2025 tally.
paragraphs.ko: 미국이 2000년 홍역 퇴치를 선언한 뒤, 그해 환자는 85명이었고 이후 보통 연 200명이 안 됐으며 대부분 해외여행과 관련됐다고 AP는 전했어요. 4월에 시작된 펜실베이니아 유행은 이전 유행들을 압도해 환자가 최소 1,561명에 이르고, 그중 1,055명이 성인이며 감염자 중 완전 접종자는 1% 미만이라고 아스 테크니카는 전했어요. CIDRAP는 그 주에서 홍역 사망자가 최소 7명이라고 집계했고, 주 보건부가 2025년과 2026년을 합쳐 사망자 13명을 보고했다고 전했어요. 앞서 사우스캐롤라이나에서 997명이 감염된 뒤 4월에 끝난 유행이 있었고, 뉴멕시코·애리조나·유타에서도 유행이 있었어요. AP는 올해 세 곳을 뺀 모든 주에서 확진 사례가 나왔고, 2026년 환자 수가 이미 2025년의 두 배 안팎이라고 전했어요.

paragraphs.en: Across the Americas, PAHO counted 58,213 confirmed cases as of Nov. 13, up from 12,806 in the same stretch of 2025, and noted the region as a whole has lacked verified elimination status since November 2025. The region regained its status in 2024 after Venezuela and Brazil halted transmission, but lost it in November 2025 when sustained spread in Canada was confirmed. A PAHO Q&A listed the 2026 leaders as Guatemala with 34,860 cases, Mexico with 13,796, the United States with 5,182, Peru with 2,928 and Canada with 1,126. Canada, which lost its own status in 2025, was described by Barbosa as the "good news" of the region after it halted the chain of transmission behind its outbreak. Even so, PAHO stressed that Canada must show 12 consecutive months without transmission before it can be re-verified, and that its outbreak was declared over on Oct. 19. Six European countries, including Britain, Spain and Austria, lost their status earlier, and the Guardian noted the UK and several others have also slipped.
paragraphs.ko: 미주 전체로는 11월 13일 기준 확진이 58,213건으로, 2025년 같은 기간의 12,806건에서 크게 늘었어요. PAHO는 이 지역 전체가 2025년 11월부터 퇴치 인정을 받지 못한 상태라고 짚었어요. 이 지역은 베네수엘라와 브라질이 전파를 멈춘 뒤 2024년에 인정을 되찾았지만, 캐나다에서 지속 전파가 확인된 2025년 11월에 다시 잃었어요. PAHO 질의응답 문서는 올해 환자가 많은 나라로 과테말라 34,860건, 멕시코 13,796건, 미국 5,182건, 페루 2,928건, 캐나다 1,126건을 꼽았어요. 2025년에 자체 인정을 잃은 캐나다에 대해 바르보사는 유행을 일으킨 전파 고리를 끊었다며 지역의 "좋은 소식"이라고 말했어요. 그래도 PAHO는 캐나다가 재인정을 받으려면 12개월 연속 전파가 없었음을 입증해야 하며, 캐나다의 유행 종료 선언은 10월 19일이었다고 강조했어요. 영국, 스페인, 오스트리아를 포함한 유럽 6개국이 앞서 인정을 잃었고, 가디언은 영국을 비롯한 여러 나라가 비슷한 처지가 됐다고 짚었어요.

paragraphs.en: Barbosa framed the moment in blunt terms, saying that losing elimination "means the virus has circulated for a prolonged period, putting families and communities at risk." "Elimination is not a trophy that is won once and placed on a shelf," he said, adding that it is "not an irreversible setback" because Brazil regained its status in 2024. The American Medical Association called the loss a "deeply troubling and entirely preventable setback for our nation," and Oregon Sen. Ron Wyden, a Democrat, called the ruling "humiliating." Several experts blamed federal health policy: Georges Benjamin of the American Public Health Association said, "They've botched this response," and some epidemiologists criticized Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Kennedy said in a post on X that the US "will stop measles outbreaks" and work to regain status, and that he would keep recommending MMR vaccination as the most effective way to prevent measles. CDC Director Erica Schwartz said, "The measles elimination designation is not what protects Americans. Vaccination does," and noted $100 million in federal grants to state and local health departments. Local officials said that sum was too small; Chrissie Juliano of the Big Cities Health Coalition said, "It wasn't a lot of money, frankly."
paragraphs.ko: 바르보사는 이 순간을 직설적으로 표현해, 퇴치 인정을 잃는 것은 "바이러스가 오랫동안 돌며 가족과 지역사회를 위험에 빠뜨렸다는 뜻"이라고 말했어요. 그는 "퇴치는 한 번 따서 선반에 올려 두는 트로피가 아니다"라고 했고, 브라질이 2024년에 지위를 되찾았기에 "되돌릴 수 없는 후퇴는 아니"라고 덧붙였어요. 미국의사협회는 이번 상실을 "매우 우려스럽고 충분히 막을 수 있었던 국가적 후퇴"라고 했고, 민주당 소속 오리건주 론 와이든 상원의원은 이번 판정이 "굴욕적"이라고 말했어요. 여러 전문가가 연방 보건 정책을 탓했어요. 미국공중보건협회의 조지스 벤저민은 "대응을 망쳤다"고 했고, 일부 역학자들은 로버트 F. 케네디 주니어 보건복지부 장관을 비판했어요. 케네디는 엑스(X)에 올린 글에서 미국이 "홍역 유행을 막고" 지위를 되찾겠다고 했으며, 홍역 예방에 가장 효과적인 방법으로 MMR 접종을 계속 권고하겠다고 밝혔어요. Brewer noted that the US exported outbreaks to Canada and Mexico, "and those cases have come back again to the US," while David Margolius of the coalition called it a "global surge in cases, global decline in vaccination rate." The AP quoted Sen. Wyden's attack on what he called "grifters, quacks and charlatans," while it also reported that Kennedy and other federal leaders have argued that vaccination rates were already waning before Trump took office again. The Guardian added that Trump had called for the combined MMR shot to be split into separate injections, arguing without evidence that taken together there could be a possibility they are "quite lethal." Georgetown's Jesse Goodman called the loss "both a national embarrassment and the tip of a dangerous iceberg," and CIDRAP's experts also pointed to older pockets of vaccine hesitancy dating back to the 1990s.

paragraphs.en: The vaccination gap is the core of the problem: the pace at which kindergartners received the MMR shot slipped to 92.4% in the 2025-26 school year, short of the 95% needed to block outbreaks, Ars Technica reported. Only 10 states meet the 95% threshold, non-medical exemptions have reached a record 4%, and 24 states have exemption rates of 5% or more. Nature reported that about 40% of this year's cases were in people aged 20 and older, and that two-thirds of Pennsylvania infections were in adults, a break from measles' image as a childhood disease. Virologist Paul Offit of Children's Hospital of Philadelphia said some Amish and Mennonite communities typically do not vaccinate, and that young adults who grew up when measles was not circulating were never naturally infected. Doctors are also seeing congenital measles again: Nature said six babies in Pennsylvania were born infected this year, and almost 100 cases were reported among pregnant people there. A preliminary analysis cited by PBS found 112 measles cases in pregnancy and 13 congenital cases nationwide from Jan. 1, 2025, to Sept. 28, 2026. UCLA's Neil Silverman warned that mumps outbreaks are already scattered across the country because the same combination jab protects against mumps and rubella.

sents.ko: AP는 주·준주 보건 책임자 협회의 수전 칸사그라가 접종이 계속 떨어지면 홍역이 다른 질병의 "탄광 속 카나리아"가 될 수 있다고 말했다고 전했어요.

sents.en: The US National Sustainability Committee's Brewer described a national path to regain status as requiring "an integrated plan that's publicly communicated with specific tasks assigned to named parties."
sents.ko: 미국 지속가능성위원회의 브루어는 지위를 되찾을 국가 계획이 "구체적 과제를 책임 주체에게 배정하고 공개적으로 알리는 통합 계획"이어야 한다고 설명했어요.

paragraphs.en: PAHO's Daniel Salas said he expects the US, Mexico and Bolivia to submit corrective action plans "in the coming weeks" explaining how they will interrupt transmission for at least a year. Barbosa urged health departments to develop bespoke campaigns for undervaccinated communities and cited Brazil's microplanning, in which municipal workers target neighborhoods with low coverage. The Brazilian political scientist Lorena Barberia told CIDRAP that public support and adherence were crucial, whereas CIDRAP's sources said abolishing personal and religious exemptions would be an important first step but is unlikely in the current political climate. Brewer said the CDC and the president should speak "forcefully" in favor of vaccination and Congress should provide more funding, while the AP noted neither Kennedy nor the CDC had scheduled a briefing that week. University of Michigan epidemiologist Jon Zelner predicted the crisis may have to worsen before the country acts, warning, "This shouldn't be the way that people learn this lesson."

views.view: The AMA called the loss of measles elimination a deeply troubling and entirely preventable setback, and critics linked it to Trump and Kennedy sowing vaccine confusion.
Experts cautioned against blaming the Trump administration alone, since measles misinformation has circulated for two decades and cases have crossed borders among the US, Canada and Mexico.
Epidemiologists warn that measles' return to the US could raise infection risks worldwide, with adults and pregnant women especially vulnerable.
PAHO calls the loss a serious warning but not irreversible, urging 95% two-dose coverage in every community plus stronger surveillance.
Experts quoted by CIDRAP call the status loss a national embarrassment and fault the federal response and cuts to public health capacity.
Ars Technica says the loss reflects earlier data and that today's runaway epidemic is worse, with Brewer warning there is no end in sight.
The AP report says the designation is largely symbolic yet signals eroding preparedness, while federal officials stress vaccination and $100 million in grants.
Johns Hopkins' William Moss says the formal status matters little to citizens; what matters is the large amount of measles circulating.

why: Losing elimination status means measles now spreads on its own inside the US, putting unvaccinated children, adults and pregnant women at higher risk.
It also shows how slipping vaccination rates can undo a public health success that took decades to build.
lines.agree: Experts across the spectrum agree that the surest way to stop measles is to raise vaccination coverage to 95% in every community.
lines.split: Experts split on blame: some fault the Trump administration and Kennedy, while others stress that vaccine misinformation and falling coverage predate them.
lines.life: For students, it is a reminder to check your own MMR vaccination record, especially before travel or study abroad in the Americas.
lines.next: Watch for the corrective action plans PAHO expects from the US, Mexico and Bolivia in the coming weeks.

why: The verdict is a major step in the US effort to hold plotters to account for the 2021 killing that left Haiti without a president.

lines.split: Sanon says he knew of no plan to kill Moïse, while prosecutors say he was the plotters' first choice to replace him.
lines.life: The case shows how a political crisis abroad can be tied to people, money and planning inside the United States.

paragraphs.en: A Florida pastor who holds both Haitian and American citizenship was convicted on Wednesday of United States charges stemming from the 2021 assassination of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse, capping a trial that lasted nearly eight weeks in federal court in Miami. Christian Emmanuel Sanon, 68, was found guilty on all eight counts he faced, among them conspiracy to kill Moïse and conspiracy to kidnap or kill a person outside the United States. He remains in federal custody, showed little reaction as the jury's verdict was read out, and faces up to life in prison when he is sentenced on Feb. 10. His lawyer, Zeljka Bozanic, said the defense team was disappointed and would appeal at the appropriate time, while prosecutors declined to comment after the verdict.
paragraphs.ko: 미국과 아이티 이중 국적을 가진 플로리다의 목사가 수요일, 2021년 아이티 대통령 조브넬 모이즈 암살에서 비롯된 미국 연방 혐의로 유죄 평결을 받았어요. 마이애미 연방법원에서 거의 8주 동안 이어진 재판의 끝이었어요. 올해 68세인 크리스천 임마누엘 사논은 그가 받은 여덟 개 혐의 전부에서 유죄로 판단됐어요. 모이즈를 살해하려 공모한 혐의와 미국 밖에 있는 사람을 납치하거나 살해하려 공모한 혐의 등이 들어 있어요. 그는 계속 연방 구금 상태예요. 배심의 평결이 낭독될 때 거의 반응을 보이지 않았고, 2월 10일 선고에서 최대 종신형을 받을 수 있어요. 그의 변호인 젤카 보자닉은 변호인단이 실망했으며 적절한 때에 항소하겠다고 말했어요. 검찰은 평결 뒤 논평을 거절했어요.

paragraphs.en: Moïse, 53, was shot dead at his home outside Port-au-Prince on July 7, 2021, in a night-time raid that also wounded his wife, Martine Moïse. Authorities have said the attackers were a squad of mostly retired Colombian soldiers who posed as agents of the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration. Haiti has had no president since, and a succession of transitional governments has followed while armed gangs, widely believed to be aided by corrupt politicians, have seized control of much of the capital and surrounding areas. The United Nations human rights office documented 4,595 people killed in armed violence between Jan. 1 and Oct. 31 this year, and the turmoil has forced nearly 1.5 million people from their homes, according to the U.N.

paragraphs.en: Prosecutors argued that South Florida served as a hub for planning and financing the scheme to oust Moïse and install a president of the plotters' choosing, and that Sanon was their first pick for the job. They said he helped raise money for the conspiracy and arranged travel to Haiti and lodging for himself and others. According to an indictment, the plot began taking final shape in April 2021, when Sanon met in South Florida with a former Haitian senator and several American businesspeople. The group agreed that once he was in power he would hand infrastructure, security and military-equipment contracts to two Florida firms, known together as CTU, investigators said. CTU first hired about 18 Colombians with military training to guard Sanon, and the conspirators spent months acquiring weapons and body armor and trying to build ties with Haitian gangs. Court records say the scheme included paying about two dozen foreign mercenaries with money obtained from U.S. government programs meant to help businesses through the COVID-19 pandemic.
paragraphs.ko: 검찰은 남플로리다가 모이즈를 몰아내고 공모자들이 고른 인물을 대통령 자리에 앉히려는 계획을 짜고 자금을 댄 거점이었다고 주장했어요. 사논이 그들이 처음 고른 후보였다고 했어요. 검찰은 그가 공모에 쓸 돈을 모으는 일을 돕고, 자신과 다른 사람들이 아이티로 가는 여행과 숙소를 마련했다고 말했어요. 공소장에 따르면 계획은 2021년 4월 사논이 남플로리다에서 아이티 전직 상원의원, 그리고 미국 사업가 몇 명과 만났을 때 마지막 모양을 갖추기 시작했어요. 수사관들에 따르면 이들은 사논이 권력을 잡으면 사회 기반 시설, 보안, 군 장비 계약을 합쳐서 CTU로 불리는 플로리다 회사 두 곳에 주기로 합의했어요. CTU는 먼저 군사 훈련을 받은 콜롬비아인 약 18명을 사논의 경호용으로 고용했고, 공모자들은 몇 달에 걸쳐 무기와 방탄복을 마련하고 아이티 갱단과 관계를 맺으려 애썼어요. 법원 기록에 따르면 이 계획에는 코로나19 팬데믹 동안 기업을 돕기 위한 미국 정부 프로그램에서 얻은 돈으로 외국인 용병 약 24명에게 대가를 치르는 일이 들어 있었어요.

paragraphs.en: Sanon took the stand and acknowledged that at one point he was in contact with people trying to replace Moïse, but he said the group had moved on to another candidate long before the killing. He denied knowing of any plan to kill the president and maintained his innocence throughout the trial. Prosecutors said that by June 2021 the conspirators realized Sanon lacked the constitutional qualifications and public support to become president, and shifted behind Wendelle Coq Thélot, a former Haitian supreme court judge who died in January 2025 while a fugitive. Sanon was born in Haiti and moved to the U.S. as a teenager, and he testified that he worked with churches in Haitian immigrant communities in Florida and the Midwest. Police in Haiti arrested him in Port-au-Prince days after the assassination, and a local police report seen by Reuters said officers found eight vehicle license plates, 19 passports, 12 mobile phones, 30 boxes of ammunition and 12 pistol holsters in his residence.

U.S. prosecutors have charged more than 40 people in connection with the assassination, and a dozen have been convicted, including five serving life sentences. A new list of indictments released in September included four people whose names were blacked out, and seven more people were charged with helping to finance the plot and helping those responsible evade justice. One of them, Vitel'homme Innocent, is a gang leader tied to the kidnapping of 17 U.S. and Canadian missionaries later in 2021, and he has yet to be arrested. Still awaiting trial are Joseph Felix Badio, a former government anti-corruption official whom lawyers for other suspects have accused of masterminding the operation, and 17 Colombian former soldiers flown in from Haiti in September.

paragraphs.en: Haiti's long history of dictatorship, political upheaval and foreign intervention, which has hindered democratic rule in the poorest country in the Americas, forms the backdrop to the case. Moïse's widow, who was flown to Florida for treatment of the bullet wounds she suffered and was a key witness at the trial, has registered as a candidate in Haiti's 2027 general election, the first in more than 10 years. The Guardian reported that a vote for a new president is scheduled for next year, and the sentencing on Feb. 10 will be the next milestone in the U.S. case.

issues.gist: Democrat Mary Peltola has won Alaska's Senate race, defeating Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan two weeks after the midterms and lifting her party to 56 seats against 44. Democrats flipped nine seats, the most since 1958, despite a spoiler-candidate row.
issues.gistKo: 민주당 메리 펠톨라가 중간선거 2주 만에 공화당 현역 댄 설리번을 꺾고 알래스카 상원 선거에서 이겨 민주당이 56대 44가 되었어요. 방해 후보 논란으로 연방·주 조사가 이어졌지만 민주당은 1958년 이후 가장 많은 아홉 석을 뒤집었어요.

views.view: Experts said ranked-choice voting made a spoiler candidate's impact unlikely; BBC Verify found Peltola would have won anyway.
Analysts expect gridlock because Trump holds the veto, and some investors fear tougher AI regulation and data center limits.
The unpopular Iran war and high gas and diesel prices hung over Republicans, and Peltola's margin was too large for the spoiler votes to matter.
Peltola's win forms the largest Senate majority either party has had in 16 years, after she out-raised Sullivan $37 million to $14 million.
Peltola overcame allegations of a recruited namesake candidate by stressing Alaska-first affordability themes.
The Justice Department has confirmed a criminal investigation and appealed the dismissal of its certification lawsuit.

paragraphs.en: Democrat Mary Peltola has won Alaska's Senate race, unseating two-term Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan and handing her party the last seat in a midterm sweep that took two full weeks of counting to confirm. The Associated Press, CBS News and NBC News projected her victory on Tuesday, Nov. 17, lifting the Democratic caucus to 56 seats against 44 for Republicans, who had entered the election holding a 53-47 majority. Alaska was the last Senate contest to be resolved after the Nov. 3 vote, a delay the BBC attributed to the logistical challenge of collecting ballots from across the state's remote expanse. Democrats flipped nine Republican-held seats in all, the most since 1958, and also won back the House of Representatives, giving the party control of Congress for the last two years of Donald Trump's presidency. NBC noted that the 56-seat total includes two independents who caucus with the party, Angus King of Maine and Bernie Sanders of Vermont, and called it the largest Senate majority either party has held in 16 years.
paragraphs.ko: 민주당의 메리 펠톨라가 알래스카 상원 선거에서 승리해 재선 의원인 공화당 현역 댄 설리번을 밀어냈고, 확정까지 꼬박 2주의 개표가 걸린 이번 중간선거 압승의 마지막 의석을 당에 안겼어요. AP통신, CBS, NBC가 11월 17일 화요일 그녀의 승리를 예측했고, 이로써 민주당 의원단은 56석, 공화당은 44석이 되었어요. 공화당은 선거 전 53대 47의 다수당이었어요. 알래스카는 11월 3일 투표 이후 마지막으로 결판난 상원 선거였는데, BBC는 외진 광활한 주 전역에서 투표용지를 모으는 일이 물류상 어려웠기 때문이라고 설명했어요. 민주당은 공화당이 갖고 있던 상원 의석 아홉 곳을 뒤집었는데 이는 1958년 이후 가장 많은 수이고, 하원도 되찾아 트럼프 대통령 임기 마지막 2년 동안 의회를 장악하게 되었어요. NBC는 56석에 민주당과 같은 의원단에 속한 무소속 둘, 메인주의 앵거스 킹과 버몬트주의 버니 샌더스가 포함된다고 짚었고, 어느 당이든 16년 만에 가장 큰 상원 다수라고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: In preliminary results on Tuesday night, with 290,003 ballots counted, Peltola took 50.1 percent of first-choice votes, or 144,302, more than all other candidates combined, while Sullivan trailed with 45.8 percent, or 131,844 votes. The Republican perennial candidate Gerald Heikes received 2.1 percent, or 6,105 votes, and Dan J. Sullivan, a retired Petersburg teacher who shares the incumbent's name, received 1.7 percent, or 4,760 votes, according to figures the Anchorage Daily News added to the AP report. Because Peltola cleared a majority of first-choice votes, the race did not go to ranked-choice tabulation, which NBC said meant any confusion over the two Sullivans did not affect the result; the BBC put her share at just over 50 percent with 99 percent of ballots counted, against less than 46 percent for the incumbent. Peltola, 53, is the first Alaska Native elected to the Senate and the first Democrat to win a Senate seat in the state since 2008, and she will be only the fifth Democrat since statehood to represent Alaska in the chamber. The last was Mark Begich, whom Sullivan defeated in 2014, and Trump carried the state by 13 points in the 2024 presidential election, when Peltola lost her bid for a second full House term to Republican Nick Begich by less than three points.
paragraphs.ko: 화요일 밤 잠정 결과에서 투표용지 290,003장을 센 시점에 펠톨라는 1순위 표의 50.1%인 144,302표로 다른 모든 후보를 합친 것보다 많았고, 설리번은 45.8%인 131,844표로 뒤졌어요. 공화당의 단골 후보 제럴드 하이크스는 2.1%인 6,105표, 현역과 이름이 같은 페터스버그의 은퇴 교사 댄 J. 설리번은 1.7%인 4,760표를 얻었다고, 앵커리지 데일리 뉴스가 AP 기사에 보탠 수치가 전했어요. 펠톨라가 1순위 표 과반을 넘겨 선호순위 개표로 가지 않았으므로 두 설리번을 둘러싼 혼선이 결과에 영향을 주지 않았다고 NBC는 말했어요. BBC는 개표율 99%에서 그녀가 50%를 조금 넘고 현역은 46%에 못 미친다고 전했어요. 53세의 펠톨라는 알래스카 원주민으로서 처음 상원에 당선되었고 2008년 이후 이 주에서 처음 상원 의석을 딴 민주당원이며, 주 승격 이후 알래스카를 상원에서 대표하는 다섯 번째 민주당원일 뿐이에요. 마지막 민주당원은 2014년 설리번에게 진 마크 베이치였어요. 트럼프는 2024년 대선에서 이 주를 13포인트 차로 이겼고, 그 해 펠톨라는 하원 두 번째 정식 임기 도전에서 공화당 닉 베이치에게 3포인트 미만으로 졌어요.

paragraphs.en: The contest was shadowed by the candidacy of a second Dan Sullivan, a political unknown who announced in June that he would challenge the senator, prompting an unsuccessful push to remove him from the ballot. He was listed as Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. with no party affiliation, while the senator appeared as Dan S. Sullivan, Republican and incumbent; he finished a distant third in the primary with about 2.5 percent, behind Peltola's 49.5 percent and the incumbent's 41.4 percent. Less than a week before Election Day, The New York Times reported, based partly on text messages, documents and interviews with Peltola's former campaign manager, that her team had worked with people who tried to recruit so-called spoiler candidates in an alleged attempt to confuse voters. The former manager had been fired shortly before the primary and later sought to recant her statements; Peltola said she "knew nothing about any other candidates on the ballot except for me and the incumbent," and the Petersburg Sullivan denied any contact with her campaign. Alaska's attorneys argued that officials should run elections without "unwarranted interference by the United States" and that the ballot distinguished the two Sullivans as far as possible, and experts told the BBC that ranked-choice voting made it hard for a spoiler to matter. A BBC Verify analysis found that even if every vote for Daniel J. Sullivan had gone to the incumbent, Peltola would still have won.

paragraphs.en: Peltola ran on affordability, tapping Alaskans' frustration with high fuel prices and other costs that weigh most heavily on remote communities reliant on diesel for electricity and heat. CBS News said the dynamics were more favorable than in 2024, with the unpopular war in Iran and high gas and diesel prices hanging over Republican candidates, and polls had shown a dead heat before election night. Her campaign posted photos of her travels around the state, and she said: "Alaskans who know me know that I'm not liberal or radical," casting herself as an independent voice for "Alaska first" rather than a national Democrat. NBC reported that she outraised Sullivan, $37 million to $14 million through mid-October, and in one ad she said he was part of a rigged system in which politicians get wealthy while diesel and health care prices rise. Sullivan, a former state attorney general and Trump ally, ran on his record of bringing energy and military investment to the state, painted her as a tool of Washington Democrats, and said that if she made an ad listing her accomplishments it would be "the shortest ad in American history." Trump and Vice President JD Vance each traveled to Alaska in the final month to back him, and the Senate Leadership Fund, the Senate Republicans' main super PAC, spent heavily, yet Peltola prevailed. Voters in Anchorage reflected the split: Sam Schimmel, who is Alaska Native, said having someone in Washington who understands life where "gas costs $17 a gallon" was "an enormous achievement," while Michael Dunn, who voted for Sullivan, said he hopes she does well.
paragraphs.ko: 펠톨라는 생활비 문제를 내세워, 전기와 난방을 디젤에 의존하는 외진 지역에 가장 무겁게 얹힌 높은 연료비와 각종 물가에 대한 알래스카 주민의 불만을 파고들었어요. CBS는 2024년보다 형세가 유리했다며, 인기 없는 이란 전쟁과 높은 휘발유·경유 가격이 공화당 후보들 위에 드리워 있었고 선거일 밤 전까지 여론조사는 접전이었다고 했어요. 그녀의 캠프는 주 곳곳을 다니는 사진을 올렸고, 그녀는 "나를 아는 알래스카인은 내가 진보도 급진도 아니라는 걸 안다"고 말하며 전국 민주당원이 아닌 '알래스카 우선'의 독자적 목소리로 자신을 내세웠어요. NBC는 그녀가 10월 중순까지 3,700만 달러 대 1,400만 달러로 설리번보다 많이 모금했다고 전했고, 한 광고에서 그녀는 디젤과 의료비가 오르는 동안 정치인만 부자가 되는 조작된 체제에 그가 속해 있다고 말했어요. 전직 주 법무장관이자 트럼프 동맹인 설리번은 주에 에너지와 군사 투자를 가져온 실적을 내세웠고, 그녀를 워싱턴 민주당의 도구로 그렸으며, 그녀가 업적을 나열한 광고를 만들면 "미국 역사상 가장 짧은 광고"일 것이라고 했어요. 트럼프와 JD 밴스 부통령은 마지막 한 달 사이 각각 알래스카를 찾아 그를 지원했고 상원 공화당의 주요 슈퍼팩인 상원리더십펀드도 거액을 썼지만, 펠톨라가 이겼어요. 앵커리지 유권자들은 엇갈린 반응을 보였어요. 알래스카 원주민 샘 쉼멜은 "휘발유가 갤런당 17달러"인 곳의 삶을 아는 사람이 워싱턴에 있다는 것이 "엄청난 성취"라고 했고, 설리번에게 투표한 마이클 던은 그녀가 잘하길 바란다고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: In her victory statement, Peltola said voters sent a message that "the status quo in DC is not working for Alaska," recalling elders in tears over empty fish racks and rural parents choosing between heating their homes and putting food on the table. She promised to take on "corporate greed," lower costs and "put Alaska first," and added: "Thank you Alaska. Let's get to work." Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer praised "a pitch-perfect campaign devoted to the issues Alaskans care most about" and said 56 seats "was an unimaginable result even just a few months ago," adding that Democrats must pass bills that lower costs and "dare Donald Trump to veto them at his own peril." Sullivan had not commented by the time of the BBC report; his spokesman Nate Adams had said the campaign would let the process "run its course until every legal vote is counted and certified," and a National Republican Senatorial Committee spokesperson did not respond to AP. On the same ballot, Alaskans elected a Democrat as governor for the first time since 1998, former state lawmaker Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, who beat three Republicans including one endorsed by Trump, while the U.S. House race between Republican Rep. Nick Begich and independent Bill Hill was still headed to ranked-choice tabulation.

BBC 보도 시점까지 설리번은 입장을 내지 않았어요. 대변인 네이트 애덤스는 선거 캠프가 "모든 합법 표가 집계되고 인증될 때까지" 절차가 진행되게 둘 것이라고 했고, 전국공화상원위원회 대변인은 AP의 요청에 답하지 않았어요. 같은 투표에서 알래스카인들은 1998년 이후 처음으로 민주당 주지사로 전직 주 의원 조너선 크라이스-톰킨스를 뽑았는데, 그는 트럼프가 지지한 후보를 포함한 공화당원 셋을 꺾었어요. 공화당 닉 베이치 하원의원과 무소속 빌 힐의 연방 하원 선거는 선호순위 개표로 가게 되어 있었어요.

sents.ko: 승리 성명에서 펠톨라는 유권자들이 "워싱턴의 현상 유지는 알래스카에 통하지 않는다"는 메시지를 보냈다고 했고, 빈 생선 건조대 앞에서 눈물짓던 어르신들과 난방과 식비 중 하나를 골라야 하는 시골 부모들을 떠올렸어요.

sents.en: She promised to take on "corporate greed," lower costs and "put Alaska first," and added: "Thank you Alaska. Let's get to work."
sents.ko: 그녀는 "기업의 탐욕"에 맞서고 비용을 낮추며 "알래스카를 우선"하겠다고 약속했고, "고맙습니다, 알래스카. 일합시다"라고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer praised "a pitch-perfect campaign devoted to the issues Alaskans care most about" and said 56 seats "was an unimaginable result even just a few months ago," adding that Democrats must pass bills that lower costs and "dare Donald Trump to veto them at his own peril."
sents.ko: 민주당 상원 원내대표 척 슈머는 "알래스카인이 가장 아끼는 문제에 매진한 완벽한 선거운동"이라 칭찬하며 56석은 "몇 달 전만 해도 상상할 수 없던 결과"라 했고, 비용을 낮추는 법안을 통과시켜 "트럼프가 거부권을 쓰려면 스스로 위험을 감수하라고 도전해야 한다"고 덧붙였어요.

sents.en: Sullivan had not commented by the time of the BBC report; his spokesman Nate Adams had said the campaign would let the process "run its course until every legal vote is counted and certified," and a National Republican Senatorial Committee spokesperson did not respond to AP.
sents.ko: BBC 보도 시점까지 설리번은 입장을 내지 않았어요. 대변인 네이트 애덤스는 선거 캠프가 "모든 합법 표가 집계되고 인증될 때까지" 절차가 진행되게 둘 것이라고 했고, 전국공화상원위원회 대변인은 AP의 요청에 답하지 않았어요.

sents.en: On the same ballot, Alaskans elected a Democrat as governor for the first time since 1998, former state lawmaker Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, who beat three Republicans including one endorsed by Trump, while the U.S. House race between Republican Rep. Nick Begich and independent Bill Hill was still headed to ranked-choice tabulation.

paragraphs.en: A DW analysis of what the result means for the economy began from the point that for many voters, the economy ranked above every other issue, with soaring gas prices playing a key role in the outcome. Markets rebounded after trending negatively at first, and global stocks rallied, although Trump has said he would become "Mr Veto" and block any legislation the Democrats advance. Stephen Brown of Capital Economics wrote that the size of the gains does little to change the near-term policy outlook because Democrats still lack a filibuster-proof majority and Trump holds the veto, and Jacob Funk Kirkegaard of the Peterson Institute said he expects "two years of complete 100% gridlock." Some investors worry Democrats could force through AI regulation, especially if they win the White House in 2028, because large majorities of Americans oppose data centers, and Kirkegaard said the vote showed the political underpinning of the AI growth story is "shaky." On tariffs, a Pew Research Center poll in early October found 56 percent of Americans expect mostly negative effects and 20 percent mostly positive, yet Deborah Elms of the Hinrich Foundation said Trump "will not be moderated," and Congress can do little to end tariffs already imposed under emergency powers. Trump said after the defeats that he would "work with" the Democrats, and a deal with Iran that lowers energy prices could ease voters' cost-of-living worries, while Kirkegaard did not rule out a new Democratic-led investigation or impeachment push that might make Trump more accommodating on tariffs.
paragraphs.ko: 이번 결과가 경제에 갖는 의미를 다룬 DW 분석은 많은 유권자에게 경제가 다른 어떤 문제보다 앞섰고 치솟는 휘발유 값이 결과에 핵심 역할을 했다는 점에서 출발했어요. 시장은 처음엔 하락 흐름이다가 반등했고 세계 증시는 올랐지만, 트럼프는 자신이 "거부권 씨"가 되어 민주당이 추진하는 어떤 법안도 막겠다고 말한 바 있어요. 캐피털 이코노믹스의 스티븐 브라운은 민주당이 아직 필리버스터를 넘길 다수가 없고 트럼프에게 거부권이 있어 승리 규모가 단기 정책 전망을 크게 바꾸지 못한다고 썼고, 피터슨국제경제연구소의 야코브 풍크 키르케고르는 "완전한 100% 교착이 2년" 이어질 것으로 봤어요. 일부 투자자는 특히 2028년 백악관까지 차지하면 민주당이 AI 규제를 밀어붙일까 걱정하는데, 미국인 다수가 데이터센터에 반대하기 때문이며, 키르케고르는 이번 표결이 AI 성장 이야기의 정치적 기반이 "불안하다"는 점을 보여 줬다고 했어요. 관세에 대해 퓨리서치센터의 10월 초 조사에서 미국인 56%는 대체로 부정적, 20%는 대체로 긍정적 영향을 예상했지만, 힌리히재단의 데버라 엘름스는 트럼프가 "누그러지지 않을 것"이라 했고, 의회가 비상 권한으로 이미 부과된 관세를 끝내기는 어렵다고 했어요. 트럼프는 참패 뒤 민주당과 "협력하겠다"고 했고, 에너지 가격을 낮추는 이란과의 합의는 유권자의 생활비 걱정을 덜 수 있어요. 키르케고르는 민주당 주도의 새 조사나 탄핵 추진이 트럼프를 관세에서 더 유연하게 만들 가능성도 배제하지 않았어요.

The Associated Press said the final ballot count and ranked-choice tabulation were scheduled for Wednesday, and Sullivan's campaign had said it would have more to say by the end of the week.
